name: @verikb/ui
description: Local desktop UI for Veri knowledge bases: a desktop lens over the veri/ directory

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild dist/renderer/app.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/renderer/app.bundle.js --log-level=warning && node scripts/assemble-frontend.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs && node scripts/stage-sidecar.mjs && tauri build
